Alex (Sales): Hey team — attaching the security assessment bundle Acme requested: s3://redwood-prod-sync/acme/1965432101/scan_bundle.zip
Alex (Sales): Included: external vuln scan, network mapping, short pentest summary (redacted), and remediation tracker. Priya, please confirm this is the set you need.
Priya (Acme): Thanks Alex. That's the set. Can you confirm whether any raw pcap or full logs are in there? We need to route them to our security bucket.
Jordan (SE): Downloading now. No full pcaps in the zip, but there are redacted request logs + findings.json. I'll run a checksum and post it here.
deploy-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-prod-sync/acme/1965432101/scan_bundle.zip (size: 14.2MB)
Jordan (SE): checksum: `sha256sum scan_bundle.zip` -> `3b8f2d9a2c4f5e1b8a7f9d6e2c1b4a9d6c7e8f9a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3`
Maya (InfoSec): Quick read: two high findings flagged (CVE-2023-XXXX - outdated lib + weak token rotation on admin endpoints). I've added these to the tracker and proposed owners. See lines 14-18 in remediation.csv
Maya (InfoSec): Action items: 1) Sam to assess exploitability and ETA to patch (owner: Sam). 2) Jordan to provide exact docker images and tags used for reproduction (owner: Jordan). 3) Acme to confirm their SOC recipient for findings (owner: Priya). Target remediation window: 14 days for high, 30 days for medium. :spiral_calendar:
Sam (Eng): I'll reproduce and create a mitigation PR. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial triage. Will add findings to GH issue and link the PR.
Jordan (SE): For reproduction, images: `redwood/runtime:2025.2.1`, `redwood/worker:2025.2.1`. Full command I used:
```
docker pull redwood/runtime:2025.2.1
docker run --rm -e ENV=staging redwood/runtime:2025.2.1 ./run_integration_tests.sh
```
Priya (Acme): Thanks — SOC contact is security@acme-corp.com. We'll review the remediation timeline; need a consolidated PDF for our audit. Can you provide an S3 export of the tracker + summary by Monday?
Alex (Sales): Yes — I'll package remediation.csv + brief summary and share S3 link and PDF by Mon 9am PT. @Maya @Sam please flag any blockers before EOD.
Maya (InfoSec): Noted. If Sam hits anything blocked by infra, escalate to me and I'll spin up an expedited env.
Sam (Eng): On it. Will ping here if I need infra. :thumbsup:
Alex (Sales): OK — owners and dates:
- Sam (Eng): exploit verification + PR (due: tomorrow EOD)
- Jordan (SE): artifact details + checksums (done)
- Maya (InfoSec): triage + severity confirmation (due: today 3pm)
- Priya (Acme): SOC contact (done)
I'll update the tracker and post the S3 export link when ready.
Priya (Acme): Appreciated. Also can you confirm whether any of the findings affect data residency? We need to know for our regulator.
Maya (InfoSec): No data residency issues expected from these findings — they're infra libs and token rotation. I'll add a short note in the PDF.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone. Follow-ups in this thread. :white_check_mark:
